entities.name: Miroslav Horníček
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miroslav Horníček was a Czech actor, writer, director, artist and theatre theoretician. He is well known in the Czech Republic for his on-stage partnership with Jan Werich, his talkshows and many small roles in Czech movies and TV.
